title: Plan a lesson (no hook)
goal: Make a lesson plan with a title, notes and a checklist, then share and save it.

startState.note: Recorded through the accessibility driver: the program runs without its demo-mode hook, and controls are found as a screen reader finds them.

intro: In this video, you plan a new lesson in Practice Planner, from a blank page to a saved and shared plan.
outro: That is a complete lesson plan, made, shared and saved.

steps.narration: Select New lesson on the toolbar. A blank lesson opens on the right.
steps.expect: A new untitled lesson is selected

steps.narration: Type a title for the lesson in the Lesson title box.
steps.expect: The title reads Sorting leaves by shape

steps.narration: In the Subject list, choose Science.

steps.value: Walk around the school field and collect ten leaves.
steps.narration: In the Notes box, write what the class will do.
steps.expect: The notes say what the class will do

steps.narration: Under Things to bring, select Add item.
Type the first thing to bring.
Now select Lesson settings on the toolbar.
steps.expect: The Lesson settings dialog is open

steps.narration: Select Share this lesson with the class page.
Select OK to close the dialog.
Finally, select Save lesson. The status line confirms it.
steps.expect: The status line says the lesson was saved
